meta.name: One Flew Over The Cuckoo's Nest
meta.description: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon finds himself as a leader to the other patients—and an enemy to the cruel, domineering nurse who runs the ward.
meta.slogan: In this clean, orderly, disciplined world, who needs guys like McMurphy? Everybody.
